description:
Activate Blood Pet by sacrificing it.
When Blood Pet dies, Mortuary and Ashes of the Abhorrent trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Blood Pet from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Ashes of the Abhorrent trigger, causing you to gain 1 life
Cast Blood Pet from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat.
